queries.sql: SELECT Title, Price FROM Books WHERE Price < 25.00 ORDER BY Price DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS BookCount, AVG(Price) AS AveragePrice FROM Books;
SELECT Author, COUNT(*) AS BooksWritten FROM Books GROUP BY Author ORDER BY BooksWritten DESC;
SELECT Books.Title, Sales.Quantity, Sales.SoldOn FROM Sales JOIN Books ON Sales.BookId = Books.BookId ORDER BY Sales.SoldOn;
SELECT Title, Price FROM Books WHERE Price >= 20.00 ORDER BY Price DESC;
SELECT BookId, COUNT(*) AS SaleEvents, SUM(Quantity) AS Copies FROM Sales GROUP BY BookId ORDER BY BookId;
